svg.text: lava-tube sea cave (echoes the Rift: overlap)
lava tube down to the gully
A steep, fluted volcanic plug in a cap of mist: tree ferns,
a waterfall into the lagoon, and a lookout above the cloud.

g.text: Ground level: tree ferns, ridges fading into the cloud.

svg.text: Mist bands hide the summit from below
View from the pod, looking west (south ← → north), with the reef wreck's mast in front. Below the water: cutaway, depth compressed.
